fields.Brand Customer Promise: Simplified travel with clean, inviting rooms, Easy Starts continental breakfast, free Wi-Fi, and budget-friendly rates—easy to find, easy to book, and easy on the wallet.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: One of the most recognized economy brands with 800+ U.S. properties; essentials for road travel including device-friendly outlets and premium movie channels; many pet-friendly locations.

Owners: Conversion flexibility tailored to specific properties in the economy segment.

Choice: Choice Privileges loyalty and Choice distribution and technology.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Easy on the road — simplify travel with trusted economy basics.

Budget essentials — clean rooms, breakfast, Wi-Fi, and entertainment options.

Recognized economy brand — national awareness in the segment.

Owner flexibility — conversion options for varied property types.
fields.Brand History: Econo Lodge is an economy brand from Choice Hotels designed to simplify travel, with more than 800 properties open in the United States.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Value-minded road travelers who prioritize a straightforward stop—clean room, quick breakfast, Wi-Fi, and low cost—over full-service amenities or design-led experiences.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Easy Stop on the Road positioning.

800+ U.S. economy properties.

Easy Starts continental breakfast and in-room device outlets.

Pet-friendly options at many locations.
